input.body:
label: bug
file: src/export/csv.ts

The CSV export function in src/export/csv.ts merges rows that have the same date, amount, and description when they have different currencies, causing only one transaction to appear in the export. This is a bug introduced after transactions started carrying a currency in version 3.2.0. The CSV writing or row grouping logic needs to be adjusted to consider currency as part of the uniqueness criteria to avoid merging distinct transactions incorrectly.

input.title: Fix currency-based row merging bug in src/export/csv.ts
input.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The current implementation of writeCsv merges rows by content but does not consider the currency field as part of the key for unique rows. This causes rows with the same date, amount and description but different currencies to be merged incorrectly, resulting in missing rows in the exported CSV.

The change needed is to update the CSV writing logic to ensure that the currency is included in the criteria that distinguishes unique rows, so rows differing only by currency do not get merged.
